proof_attempt_summary: Six D0 solve rounds established a reviewed, sound informal first stage: nonsharp original-record risk and finite-even-sample 0.90 honest connected-interval length bounds, finite coefficient-score certificates with uniform grid/truncation controls, supplied regularized-path information enclosures, actual-record finite-path LAN and local converses, and a published-class converse transfer. The scaled-risk sanity lower benchmark is 4/3 and the upper coefficient is 308/111, but no contracting optimized certificate gap or effective uniform schedule controlling growing tangent norms, support regularization, boundaries and tails was proved. Exact minimax limits/constants, worst configurations and sharp original-record attainers remain conditional on effective information exhaustion; the run stopped before F1 and has no Lean proof.
tldr: Exact conditional effect homogeneity permits parametric-order precision at bounded occupancy. The proved spine gives original-record nonsharp squared-risk and finite-sample honest connected-interval bounds, finite score and legal-path certificates with uniform grid and truncation errors, supplied-path information-tail bounds, and finite-path original-mark LAN and local decision converses. The maintained benchmark has two public occupancies and arbitrary deterministic propensity and baseline arrays. Its converses also transfer to the full arbitrary-mass homogeneous slice of the published observed-law model, while its upper bounds remain benchmark-specific. Exact constants, sharp original-record rules and an effective sharp-intensity modulus remain conditional on effective information exhaustion; the joint sharp-precision question remains open. This is a prospective binary savings precision benchmark for the saving-program causal question, without an empirical reanalysis.
gap: Zeng et al. closes the homogeneous occupancy rate. The restricted estimating-function bounds, Strasser\textquotesingle s scalar strongly equidistributed-array transfer, and Qiu et al.\textquotesingle s bounded sparse-stratum limit theory do not establish effectively computable sharp risk and finite-sample honest-length constants for arbitrary deterministic two-coordinate arrays.
fill: First certify finite primal and legal-path dual computations with explicit uniform error envelopes. Resolve effective exhaustion and boundary regularization, then derive exact all-procedure constants and total original-record rules with sharp uniform precision and finite-sample connected coverage, including the public-intensity robustness target.
